name: open_web_extension
description: Installs a web extension through WebDriver BiDi and opens one of its extension pages so existing MCP tools can inspect and drive its UI. Requires a BiDi-enabled browser session. Use base64 for cloud/remote sessions where the browser driver cannot read the MCP server filesystem.

extensionData.description: W3C BiDi webExtension.ExtensionData: unpacked directory path, archive path, or base64 archive.

path.description: Path to an unpacked extension directory on the remote end.
Path to a packaged extension archive on the remote end.
Path inside the extension package, such as options.html or popup.html. Leading slashes are ignored.
